name: Ikeda (Nagano, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ikeda town emblem in green and blue: two green curved strokes forming a swirl around a blue disc.
history: Municipal flag of Ikeda, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1966.

features.role: Ikeda town emblem — two green curved strokes forming a swirl around a blue disc
